(2) Which routes need auth is defined in UserModule.configure by repeating path strings ('user' GET/PUT). These must stay in sync with the controller's route decorators, and DELETE 'users/:slug' is left without auth. (3) ValidationPipe is applied to create and login but not to update, so UpdateUserDto is never validated, and delete takes untyped params. user.service.ts was not provided, so finding (1) is inferred from the service's signatures.
